name: KeyboardDrawer
description:
An on-screen keyboard docked to the bottom of the viewport (or a `container`), for
kiosks and touch screens. Non-modal: no scrim, no focus trap, and pointer presses on it
never take focus from the input it types into, so the page stays usable around it.

It slides up and down on the motion tokens (at once under Still or reduced motion),
keeps its last row above the home indicator (safe area), spans a phone's width and is
centred with a maximum width on larger screens. Its material follows the appearance
settings (Glass, Frosted, Solid, Flat); `glass` sets this drawer's own level.

While open it sets `--keyboard-inset-height` (its height in px) on `scrollRoot` —
`document.documentElement` by default — so a layout can pad its scroll container's
content with `var(--keyboard-inset-height, 0px)`, and scrolls `target` into view above
itself (only as far as needed). Without that padding a field at the very end of a
scroller cannot rise above the drawer.
Escape (in the target or on the keyboard) and the hide key close it.

To open it when a field gains focus, use OnScreenKeyboardProvider and KeyboardTarget.
signature: ({ open: openProp, defaultOpen, onOpenChange, container, scrollRoot, glass, panelClassName, panelRef, target, size, ...keyboard }: KeyboardDrawerProps): import("react").JSX.Element | null

props.name: captureTyping
props.description: Physical keys typed while focus is on the keyboard edit the text or target. Default true.

props.name: container
props.description:
Dock to the bottom of this element instead of the viewport, and render into it. It must
be a containing block (`position: relative`) that does not scroll itself, such as a
window's or a kiosk frame's outer element. Default: the viewport (rendered into the
full-screen element when there is one, else the body).

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the drawer starts shown when uncontrolled. Default false.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial text when uncontrolled and without a target. Default "".

props.name: disabled
props.description: Every key is disabled.

props.name: enterKind
props.description: The Enter key's label and colour. Default: the target's `enterkeyhint`, else "enter".

props.name: glass
props.description: The drawer's own material level: `full` (Glass), `reduced` (Frosted) or `solid`. Default: the page's.

props.name: layout
props.description: The layout shown: a layout or a built-in identifier. Default: the first of `layouts`, else the locale's layout (`layoutForLocale`). A new value replaces the shown layout.

props.name: layouts
props.description: The layouts the globe key cycles through. Omit, or give one, for no globe key.

props.name: locale
props.description: Overrides the locale for the default layout, `decimal` and `alphabet`.

props.name: onEnter
props.description:
Called when Enter is pressed. Unless prevented, an input target gets an Enter keydown
and then its form is submitted (requestSubmit); a textarea or contenteditable target
gets a new line.

props.name: onKeyPress
props.description: Called for every press, before the keyboard acts; `details.preventDefault()` skips the action.

props.name: onLayoutChange
props.description: Called with the layout the globe key moved to.

props.name: onNavigateOut
props.description: Called when an arrow key is pressed at the keyboard's edge, with the screen direction: move focus to the results beside it.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the next open state and why: Escape (in the target or on the keyboard) or the hide key.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new text after each edit when the keyboard owns the text (no `target`).

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the drawer is shown. Pair with `onOpenChange` to control it.

props.name: panelClassName
props.description: A class for the drawer panel (the keyboard takes `className`).

props.name: panelRef
props.description: The drawer panel element, while it is mounted.

props.name: scrollRoot
props.description:
The element that receives `--keyboard-inset-height` (the drawer's height, in px) while
the drawer is open; it inherits to everything inside. Default: `container`, else
`document.documentElement`. In a Glass UX layout the document never scrolls, so pad the
scroll container's content with it, and the last fields can scroll above the drawer:
`padding-block-end: var(--keyboard-inset-height, 0px)`.

props.name: showAlternates
props.description: Press and hold (500 ms, or a held Enter) offers accented alternates. Default true.

props.name: size
props.description: Key size: sm for narrow panels, md (default) about a control's height, lg for TVs viewed from across a room.

props.name: target
props.description:
An input, textarea or contenteditable element to type into, or a ref to one. The
keyboard edits it at its caret and fires `input` events, so React-controlled inputs
update. Pointer presses never take focus from it.

props.name: value
props.description: The text, when the keyboard owns it (no `target`). Pair with `onValueChange`.

props.name: variant
props.description: keys: separate keycaps (the default for typing layouts); grid: flat tiles (the default for grid layouts: the alphabet, number pads).

props.name: wrap
props.description: Arrow keys continue from the far side at an edge, instead of calling `onNavigateOut`. Default false.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
